subject: Procurement next steps — vendor packet, tax forms, and payment path
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Procurement next steps — vendor packet, tax forms, and payment path

Hi Laura,

Great to meet the team earlier — thanks for the time and for walking through the integration priorities. Per our demo, I wanted to summarize the procurement items we typically need so your procurement/payables team can pick the path that works best for Acme.

Quick recap and asks:
- Vendor setup packet: we can provide a standard packet (company details, insurance, contacts). I attached the vendor_packet_v1.pdf for the intake fields.
- Tax form: we have a completed W-9 (attached). If you need a W-8 instead, let me know and we will generate it.
- Banking details: attached a bank_details_template.xlsx with the fields your AP team usually requests. We don't include sensitive account numbers in email — we'll add them into the secure vendor portal or a protected form.
- Payment path: we accept PO (invoice), corporate card, or marketplace (AWS Marketplace listing in progress). Please let us know which route Acme prefers.

If PO is preferred: typical flow is vendor packet + signed SOW -> invoice to procurement@acme-retail.com -> payment terms net 30 (we can discuss). If card: we can process immediately after vendor setup. If marketplace: there is an onboarding lead time for listing and transacting via the marketplace.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Confirm preferred payment path (PO / card / marketplace) — please loop in your procurement contact.
2) If PO, confirm any additional forms or tax classification requirements (do you need a 1099-related process?).
3) We will upload bank routing info into the secure vendor portal once you confirm the path you prefer.

Attachments: vendor_packet_v1.pdf (PDF), W-9_Redwood_Inference.pdf (PDF), bank_details_template.xlsx

Thanks — I will follow up with Ben from Sales Ops on the vendor packet details.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Grace — thanks for the clear summary and the packet. Two quick clarifications from AP:

1) Acme prefers PO for enterprise agreements, but we'll need the W-9 and the company EIN on file. The W-9 you attached looks good; can you confirm the EIN number and the legal entity name you will invoice under?

2) Do you already have an AWS Marketplace listing or is that future? If you have a marketplace SKU, we can route through procurement portal (preferred for cloud spend). If not, we will proceed with PO.

I'll have procurement@acme-retail.com start the vendor intake once we confirm the EIN and invoice name. Also invite my colleague Michael (copied) — he handles vendor registration and will confirm whether we need any additional insurance certificates.

Can you confirm those two items and whether you can accept net 30?

Best,
Laura Chen
Director, Strategic Programs | Acme Retail
laura.chen@acme-retail.com

Laura / Michael / Procurement team —

Thanks for the quick replies. To keep momentum, proposed action items and timeline: 

Action items (mutual action plan):
- Acme: Confirm payment path (PO vs card vs marketplace) and provide procurement intake link (if you have one). Target: end of week (2027-08-20).
- Acme: Confirm whether any additional forms are required (insurance certificate, W-8 instead of W-9 for foreign entities).
- Redwood: Prepare draft SOW and push to DocuSign for signature if PO is chosen. I’ve attached a draft SOW for review; we’ll revise per your feedback.
- Redwood Finance (Priya): Will issue invoice on receipt of signed SOW and completed vendor packet. If card is chosen, no SOW required for initial pilot subscription.

Proposed timeline if PO path chosen:
1) Today: Acme confirms scope + invoicing entity.
2) Within 2 business days: Redwood sends draft SOW (attached) via DocuSign.
3) After signature: Redwood submits invoice to procurement@acme-retail.com -> net 30 payment.

Links and attachments:
- Draft SOW (SOW-Redwood-Acme-draft.docx) attached.
- DocuSign SOW: https://docusign.example.com/rooms/DEAL-4912-sow
- Vendor portal: https://portal.redwood.ai/vendor-setup/4912

If PO is the chosen path, Michael, would you like Ben and I to join your intake call to accelerate the packet? We want to avoid back-and-forth if there are custom fields in your portal.

Thanks again — we’ll stand by for confirmation and will move SOW to DocuSign as soon as we hear back.

Best,
